
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Returns the index of the first column in a single-precision complex
    floating-point input matrix which has the same elements as a provided search
    vector.

    If unable to find a matching column or if provided an empty matrix, the
    function returns -1.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing the following ndarrays:

        - a two-dimensional input ndarray corresponding to `A`.
        - a one-dimensional input ndarray corresponding to `x`.
        - a one-dimensional workspace ndarray.

    Returns
    -------
    out: integer
        Column index.

    Examples
    --------
    > var Complex64Array = {{alias:@stdlib/array/complex64}};
    > var Uint8Array = {{alias:@stdlib/array/uint8}};
    > var ndarray = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/ctor}};
    > var abuf = new Complex64Array( [ 1.0, 0.0, 2.0, 0.0, 3.0, 0.0, 4.0, 0.0 ] );
    > var A = new ndarray( 'complex64', abuf, [ 2, 2 ], [ 2, 1 ], 0, 'row-major' );
    > var xbuf = new Complex64Array( [ 2.0, 0.0, 4.0, 0.0 ] );
    > var x = new ndarray( 'complex64', xbuf, [ 2 ], [ 1 ], 0, 'row-major' );
    > var wbuf = new Uint8Array( 2 );
    > var w = new ndarray( 'uint8', wbuf, [ 2 ], [ 1 ], 0, 'row-major' );
    > {{alias}}( [ A, x, w ] )
    1

    See Also
    --------
